description: Item marks (core/interface/item_marks/): a gold star on the icon of a consumable that is the direct upgrade of another with the same icon and colour, everywhere; and a pulsing gold halo with three twinkling stars behind and around a rare material on the quest rewards screen only. Mod Settings > Interface, the page's only, both on by default. Items by their English names (the game's, the ported monsters' and XX's new items: every id of a name).

rare.description: The rare materials that shine on the quest rewards screen: gems and the like (Wyvern Tears, marrows, pearls, gold, horns and eyes are not rare).

upgrades.description: Each upgrade, the item it improves (same icon shape and colour: checked against the game's item table) and its stars: 1, or 2 for an upgrade of an upgrade. Mega Pickaxe and Mega Bug Net are left out: their colour already tells them apart.

star_size.description: The upgrade star's side in pixels on a 16-px and on a 24-px icon (both scale with the icon).

star_inset.description: The gap in pixels between the icon's top-left corner and its stars' box, on both axes: the stars stay inside the icon's square (checked with back_shift and back_lift for both icon sizes).

back_shift.description: Two stars: the back one's shift to the right, times the star's side, rounded to a pixel.

back_lift.description: Two stars: the back one stands this many pixels higher than the front one (the front one goes down by it, so the back one stays inside the square).

gold.description: Gold (RGB): the rare rewards' twinkles, and the upgrade stars when Mod Settings' Star Colour is Yellow (its value's setting "gold"). A star is the sheet's grey art times its colour.

white.description: White (RGB): the upgrade stars when Mod Settings' Star Colour is White (its value's setting "white").

halo_size.description: The rare halo's side in pixels on a 16-px icon, centred on it.

halo_alpha.description: The halo's opacity at the low and the high of its pulse (a sine over one cycle).

cycle_seconds.description: One cycle of the rare effect: the halo's pulse and each twinkle's turn.

twinkle_places.description: Each twinkling star's middle, in pixels from a 16-px icon's top-left corner, in their turns' order (one starts every third of a cycle).

twinkle_sizes.description: A twinkle's side in pixels through its life, each size for the same time.

twinkle_life.description: A twinkle's life, in cycles; the rest of the cycle it is hidden.

reserve.description: Free places the GUI's pane and sprite pools keep: a star is made only above them (the game takes from the pools without checking: texts laid out again and up to 1,512 redraw nodes; at least 5,519 panes and 2,401 sprites were free in 86 kept save states).
